name: call_routine_five_times
description: Calls the same unnamed routine five times in succession, then stores a value back into a global with no change and returns.

name: call_routine_four_times
description: Calls the same unnamed routine four times in succession, then performs a self-assignment on a global and returns.

name: store_constant_and_dispatch
description: Writes the constant 12345 through a global pointer, then calls three unnamed routines in sequence.

name: invoke_external_then_three_routines
description: Calls one routine at a fixed external address, then calls three unnamed routines in sequence before returning.

name: enter_infinite_loop
description: Spins in an empty loop that never exits and never returns to its caller, so control stops at this point once reached.

name: clear_ten_thousand_longwords
description: Writes zero to 10000 consecutive longwords starting at a fixed address using a countdown loop. It is called from one unnamed routine.

name: clear_block_via_base_pointer
description: Zeroes 10000 consecutive longwords starting at a pointer read from a slot in the base-relative data area. It is called from two unnamed routines.

name: copy_fixed_block_to_buffer
description: Copies 10000 consecutive longwords from a fixed source area to a destination read from a base-relative pointer slot. It is called from one unnamed routine.

name: copy_fixed_block_to_buffer
description: Copies 10000 consecutive longwords from a fixed source area to a destination read from a base-relative pointer slot. The code is identical to its neighbour and is reached through a stored address.

name: update_step_duration_by_index
description: Waits until a busy flag clears, then refreshes a cached value and an increment from a table when the current index is below twelve and has changed. It sets a timing value of 2, 4 or 3 depending on whether the index is 6, 10 or other, then sets the busy flag.

name: clear_state_then_call
description: Clears one state variable and then calls an unnamed routine. It is called from four unnamed routines.

name: return_result_if_active
description: Returns zero when a state word is clear, otherwise it returns the value produced by a follow-up unnamed routine.

name: reset_record_status_words
description: Zeroes four 16-bit fields at fixed offsets from a base record pointer and stores 15 into a fifth field. It is called from two unnamed routines.

name: clear_record_word_block
description: Zeroes 24 consecutive 16-bit words of a record located at a fixed offset from the base pointer.

name: advance_copper_frame_timer
description: Decrements a frame countdown and reloads or calls the copper setup routine when it expires, touching the copper list pointer register and reading the video position register. Otherwise it runs a tail of helper calls and clears a sync word.

name: dispatch_state_handler_table
description: Runs a per-frame service step, clears a pending flag and resets five table entries to a fixed value when it is set, then jumps through a handler table indexed by a state word.

name: wait_for_flag_clear
description: Sets a flag to one, calls an unnamed routine, then spins until the flag is cleared by another routine. It acts as a synchronisation handshake.

name: poll_pending_sequence_byte
description: Returns the next queued sequence byte after clearing its pending slot, or zero when nothing is queued. When a pending flag is active it stores a fixed countdown and passes control to a queued routine.

name: poll_pending_sequence_entry
description: Returns the next queued sequence byte, using the same pending-flag logic as its neighbour but with a different slot check. When nothing is queued it returns zero.

name: poll_sequence_flag_entry
description: Returns the next queued sequence byte, testing a separate global flag before consuming a pending entry. When no entry is queued it returns zero.

name: poll_secondary_sequence_queue
description: Returns the next queued sequence byte from a secondary pending slot, or zero when both queues are empty. It clears the pending slots as it reads and passes control to an unnamed routine when an entry is taken.

name: drain_pending_sequence_state
description: Clears a pending flag when set, then either dispatches a queued entry or marks the secondary queue as active. When no pending state remains it returns without further action.

name: reset_sequence_counter_if_idle
description: Sets a counter to 127 when a status word is zero, then clears a pending flag.

name: latch_sequence_index_value
description: Stores the low seven bits of the input value as the pending sequence index, clears two pending slots and calls an unnamed routine.

name: advance_sequence_index
description: Clears a secondary flag and, unless the index has reached twelve, increments the index, resets its slot and calls an unnamed routine.

name: reset_pending_sequence_slots
description: Clears two pending sequence slots and calls an unnamed routine, then returns without further change.

name: arm_sequence_countdown_dispatch
description: Sets a countdown to five, copies a stored value into the sequence slot, records a dispatch pointer and clears a pending flag, then calls an unnamed routine.

name: advance_sequence_or_dispatch
description: Clears a pending flag; when the step index is zero it clears the secondary flag and advances the index unless it has reached twelve. Otherwise it stores the dispatch pointer, calls an unnamed routine and clears two pending values.

name: dispatch_sequence_entry_and_clear
description: Stores the dispatch pointer and step index, calls an unnamed routine, then clears a pending flag and calls a second routine.

name: classify_timing_window_mode
description: Compares a timing value against two bounds and a mode word, returning minus one or one when the mode does not match the expected code, and the incoming value otherwise.

name: build_masked_output_table
description: Computes 32 words by masking a lookup value against a stored value shifted by a table entry, writing them to a fixed output table. It repeats the calculation for each destination in a zero-terminated list.

name: clear_flagged_record_bytes
description: Walks a block of 12-byte records and, for each one with its pending flag set, clears the flag and zeroes one byte at the stored offset in the buffer.

name: allocate_free_record_slot
description: Calls an unnamed routine to get an index, and if a guard word is clear and that index is not yet active, claims the first free 12-byte record and stores the index, a table value and a zero field into it.

name: allocate_slot_when_pending
description: When a pending countdown is set it clears it and allocates the first free 12-byte record for the current index, returning the index times four on success. When nothing is pending it returns zero.

name: process_active_record_entries
description: Walks the 12-byte record table and calls an unnamed routine for each active record, counting how many were processed. It first calls another routine when the current index is below ten and its entry is set.

name: run_record_handler_after_delay
description: Decrements a record's delay field and returns while it is nonzero; once it reaches zero, it saves the record pointer and calls the handler stored in that record.

name: copy_fixed_block_to_buffer
description: Copies 10000 consecutive longwords from a fixed source area to a destination read from a base-relative pointer slot. It is called from one unnamed routine.

name: mix_table_lookup_result
description: Builds a table index from a byte and its successor, reads a word from that table and returns the word's high byte with its low byte XOR-ed against the input byte.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without performing any operation. It is an empty stub reached from a gap in the code.

name: bump_counter_and_dispatch
description: Increments a counter at a fixed address, sets a state variable to four and calls an unnamed routine, then returns the input registers unchanged. The hardware facts list the interrupt request register for this routine.

name: poll_until_state_value
description: Calls an unnamed routine once, then keeps calling it in a loop until a state word equals 80.

name: refresh_lookup_pending_value
description: Looks up a value from a table using a state word, sets the top bit when the entry is 63, and stores the result as the pending value if it differs from the last one; otherwise it clears the pending value.

name: apply_pending_table_matches
description: When the pending value is nonzero, walks a four-word table and, for each entry whose key matches, writes its second word to the location its pointer names and calls an unnamed routine.

name: decode_step_index_byte
description: When the input byte has its top bit set, takes the low five bits as the step index, marks a pending flag if the index changed, and clears the input byte.

name: build_four_entry_word_table
description: Builds a four-entry table of words by adding 8000 per step to the sum of two stored offsets and storing the high and low halves. A state check first resets a stored value to 120000 when the state is at least two.

name: build_four_entry_word_table
description: Builds the same four-entry word table as its neighbour, adding 8000 per step to the sum of two stored offsets and storing the high and low halves. It is called from two unnamed routines.

name: toggle_stored_value_and_pointer
description: Saves a stored timing value and calls an unnamed routine, then alternates a stored value between 120000 and 80000 and points a global at one of two fixed addresses to match.

name: set_fixed_global_pointer
description: Points a global variable at a fixed address and returns. It is called from one unnamed routine.

name: read_joystick_button_bits
description: Reads the direction and fire-button bits of the controller port and packs them into a four-bit mask, storing it with a changed-state word when it differs from the previous read. The hardware facts list CIA port A as holding the fire buttons and disk status.

name: accumulate_clamped_velocity
description: Adds a signed velocity to a 32-bit accumulator, clamping it to zero at the bottom and to 64 at the top. When a mode flag equals one it writes half the accumulator to an output field.

name: copy_two_word_tables
description: Copies 30 words from one fixed table into a fixed destination, then copies 15 words from a second table into another destination. It is called from four unnamed routines.

name: copy_two_word_tables
description: Copies 30 words from one fixed table into a fixed destination, then copies 15 words from a second table into another destination. It is the same code as its neighbour and is called from four unnamed routines.

name: store_entry_in_free_slot
description: Scans an array of 20-byte entries for one that is not in use, then stores four words in it and sets its active flag.

name: process_flagged_entries
description: Walks the 20-byte entries and calls an unnamed routine for each one whose first or second flag is set.

name: clear_ready_flag_and_return
description: Clears an entry's ready flag, calls an unnamed routine and returns. The remaining setup code after that call is never reached in this decode.

name: fill_entry_fields_stepped
description: Clears an entry's flag, reads stored words and an offset, calls two unnamed routines and writes fixed words into a structure. It then stores four values stepped by 8000 into consecutive fields.

name: run_entry_update_when_ready
description: When an entry's field is nonnegative it calls an unnamed routine and, if the entry slot is valid, stores the result, calls a second routine and records a marker when a companion flag is zero.

name: set_interrupt_request_flags
description: Writes a fixed value to the interrupt request register, then calls an unnamed routine when a pending value is nonzero and clears that value.

name: set_interrupt_request_flag
description: Writes a fixed value to the interrupt request register when a stored value is nonzero, leaving the register unchanged otherwise.

name: write_triple_marker_record
description: Writes three parameter words into a buffer while advancing its write pointer, first checking that the second word is not the value 12346. It finishes by writing the constant 12345 at the new position.

name: wait_blitter_idle_then_reset
description: Writes a DMA-style control word with its set bit on, waits while a busy status bit remains set, then writes a lower control value.

name: clear_fields_walk_record_list
description: Clears four 16-bit fields and sets two others to fixed values, then calls an unnamed routine for each record in a list until the sentinel 12345 is reached, and writes that sentinel at the list head.

name: fill_stepped_table_entries
description: Writes a pair of fields to a structure, then fills four consecutive table entries from a base value, stepping by 8000 each time. It is called from one unnamed routine.

name: fill_stepped_table_from_bases
description: Clears four structure fields, sets two from a parameter and fills four consecutive table entries from two base values, each stepped by 8000. The loop ends early if its count reaches zero.

name: repeat_store_call_results
description: Repeats a call to an unnamed routine a counted number of times, storing its two results and a parameter into a structure on each pass.

name: walk_records_until_sentinel
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then walks a list of three-word records and calls another routine for each record whose first word is nonnegative, until the sentinel 12345 is found.

name: append_record_and_setup_fields
description: Returns early when its first parameter is minus one. Otherwise it appends a three-word record to a list, terminates the list with 12345, configures a set of fields and fills stepped table entries, returning the result of the last helper call.

name: compute_clipped_offset_parameters
description: Looks up two table values for an index, clamps a computed offset against the table limit and derives output parameters, returning early when the position is out of range.

name: rebuild_record_buffer
description: Selects one of two buffers and clears eight rows of it, initialising each row's fields to a default of 150. It then walks a zero-terminated record list and stores clipped values and per-row indices into a table.

name: swap_buffer_pointer_table
description: Fills seven table entries with buffer pointers stepped by 608 bytes, then flips the active buffer selector.

name: write_sequence_row_bytes
description: Writes four computed bytes into two row buffers and advances a row offset. The decompiler reports bad instruction data after this point, so the tail of the routine is unreliable.

name: initialise_record_defaults
description: Clears two record fields, sets two fields to fixed values and a count to four, then calls an unnamed routine. Some stores in the decode are self-assignment placeholders.

name: reset_record_fields_and_call
description: Clears two record fields, sets two fixed values and a count of four, then calls an unnamed routine. It differs from its neighbour only in the fields it omits.

name: reset_record_fields_partial
description: Sets two record fields to zero and two to fixed values, then calls an unnamed routine. It does not write the count field.

name: reset_record_fields_and_clear
description: Clears several record fields to defaults and calls an unnamed routine. The decoded body is short, so much of the original logic is not visible here.

name: reset_record_state_defaults
description: Clears two fields, sets two to fixed values and a count to four, then calls an unnamed routine. It is called from two unnamed routines.

name: emit_mode_byte_sequence
description: Clears a pending flag and, if it was set, writes a fixed sequence of codes chosen by whether the mode value is one, then calls an unnamed routine.

name: load_indexed_word_and_call
description: Loads a 16-bit value from a table indexed by a global selector into a variable, then calls an unnamed routine.

name: decrement_active_countdowns
description: Decrements each of four countdown variables when it is nonzero, leaving zero counters unchanged.

name: wait_busy_then_return_byte
description: Waits while a busy byte is nonzero, clears a companion variable and returns the input byte with bit six set.

name: call_when_countdown_idle
description: Calls an unnamed routine when a countdown variable is zero, then returns zero in all cases.

name: update_channel_volume_and_pointer
description: Computes a scaled volume from two stored values and writes it to a channel record. When a restart flag is set it reloads two stored values, selects the next state and returns early for mode four.

name: update_channel_sample_pointer
description: Computes a scaled volume and, when a restart flag is set, writes a sample pointer and length into the channel block and sets its state. The routine's hardware facts list the DMA control and interrupt registers.

name: sequence_channel_step_value
description: Calls two unnamed routines and a third that yields a value. When a flag is set it returns a stored value, and when that value is nonzero and a counter reaches zero it calls another routine to produce the result.

name: tick_channel_counter_value
description: Returns a stored value and decrements a counter when it is nonzero; when the counter reaches zero and the value is nonzero it calls a routine. Otherwise it returns the input.

name: advance_envelope_stages
description: Advances a multi-stage level envelope: one phase steps the level up toward a limit read from a table, a later phase steps it down to a sustain level and holds it, and a final phase fades it to zero. Stage counters are updated on each call.

name: process_three_channel_commands
description: Processes three fixed-size channel records, reading each record's byte-coded command stream. An escape byte sets a parameter from the following byte, and any other byte selects a note that updates the channel's sample pointer and volume. The routine's hardware facts list the DMA and interrupt registers.

name: read_channel_command_stream
description: Reads the byte-coded command stream for one channel record. An escape byte sets a parameter from the next byte, and any other value is treated as a note that updates its sample pointer and volume.

name: copy_word_field_triples
description: Copies two word fields to two other offsets in a structure, moving the base pointer two bytes per pass, and repeats this for three passes.

name: copy_word_field_pairs
description: Copies two word fields to two other offsets in a structure, moving the base pointer two bytes per pass, and repeats this for two passes.

name: reset_volume_and_pointer_table
description: Sets the volume scale to 64, looks up a starting value from a table by the current index and rebuilds a 30-entry pointer table from a byte-indexed list. It then clears four channel volume fields and several globals.

name: scale_audio_channel_volumes
description: Multiplies four stored channel volumes by a master value divided by 64 and writes them to the four audio volume registers, skipping two of them in one mode. When the master value is full, the volumes are copied unchanged.

name: rebuild_pointer_table_and_clear
description: Rebuilds a 30-entry pointer table from a byte-indexed list and clears four channel volume fields and several globals. The volume scale is left unchanged here.

name: rebuild_pointer_table_and_clear
description: Rebuilds a 30-entry pointer table from a byte-indexed list and clears four channel volume fields and several globals. It is called from three unnamed routines.

name: rebuild_pointer_table_and_clear
description: Rebuilds a 30-entry pointer table from a byte-indexed list and clears four channel volume fields and several globals. It is called from one unnamed routine.

name: rebuild_pointer_table_and_clear
description: Rebuilds a 30-entry pointer table from a byte-indexed list and clears four channel volume fields and several globals. It is called from one unnamed routine.

name: rebuild_pointer_table_and_clear
description: Rebuilds a 30-entry pointer table from a byte-indexed list and clears four channel volume fields and several globals. It is called from three unnamed routines.

name: rebuild_pointer_table_and_clear
description: Rebuilds a 30-entry pointer table from a byte-indexed list and clears four channel volume fields and several globals. It is called from one unnamed routine.

name: rebuild_pointer_table_and_clear
description: Rebuilds the pointer table and clears four channel volume fields and globals. The facts list the four audio volume registers as touched, and the routine is called from four unnamed routines.

name: clear_channel_volume_and_mask
description: Clears four channel volume fields and several globals, then stores fifteen into a control global. The facts list the audio volume registers and the DMA control register for this routine.

name: advance_audio_playback_step
description: Advances a playback step counter and loads the audio channel location registers from stored pointers, with two short delay loops around the writes. The four audio location registers are listed among the routine's hardware facts.

name: set_indexed_flag
description: Sets the byte flag selected by an index argument to one and returns.

name: configure_audio_dma_channels
description: Configures the audio location and length registers for the four channels and enables DMA through the DMA control register, as the listed hardware facts show. The decompiler timed out, so the detailed logic is not described here; it calls a routine that masks a word to twelve bits.

name: apply_channel_effect_nibble
description: Updates a channel's effect state according to a low command nibble: several modes step a period word with clamping, one mode computes a scaled volume offset and another adjusts a level. The stored period is masked to twelve bits.

name: boot_decode_compressed_stream
description: Boot block entry that makes three library calls to set up requests, clears a memory region to zero and decodes a compressed byte stream into it. Repeat markers (the byte 139) are expanded into runs, and the copper list pointer register is listed as touched.

key: Hunter (1991)(Activision)(Fr)[cr PRD][b].adf boot-block load +$13400 to $070000 (5632 bytes):0:0000
name: decode_compressed_byte_stream
description: Decodes a compressed byte stream into a memory region, expanding repeat markers (the byte 139) into runs and refilling its bit reader from the source. It loops until the output pointer reaches the end boundary.

key: Hunter (1991)(Activision)(Fr)[cr PRD][b].adf boot-block load +$13400 to $070000 (5632 bytes):0:00F6
name: refill_bit_reader_word
description: Writes a byte to a destination and returns the source longword shifted right one bit with its top bit set. It is the bit reader used by the decoder.

key: Hunter (1991)(Activision)(Fr)[cr PRD][b].adf boot-block load +$13400 to $070000 (5632 bytes):0:0110
name: shift_bit_buffer_count
description: Shifts a bit buffer right by a count, refilling it from the source when it becomes empty. It is called from five unnamed routines.

key: Hunter (1991)(Activision)(Fr)[cr PRD][b].adf boot-block load +$400 to $070000 (10240 bytes):0:0082
name: delay_loop_return_zero
description: Runs a counted loop that cycles a small byte counter, produces no visible output and returns zero. It appears to be a timing delay.

name: load_table_entry_fields
description: Loads five fields of a record from the table row selected by the input index, adding one to the first field.

name: copy_record_fields_with_derived
description: Copies six fields from a source record into two destination records, computing some derived values such as shifted and multiplied fields.

name: adjust_longword_by_constant
description: Adds a fixed constant to the longword at the pointer argument.

name: store_position_pair_fields
description: Stores two input words into a record, then stores each again at a fixed offset from its original position, along with two further words.

name: copy_ten_word_table_row
description: Copies ten consecutive words from a table row, selected by the first argument, into a record selected by the second argument.

name: load_table_row_into_record
description: Loads a table row into a working record, copying ten words and a block of values, then sets derived pointer and size fields and calls helpers to finish. A pointer is stored conditionally when a field is nonnegative.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without performing any operation. It is an empty stub.

name: fill_four_stepped_long_entries
description: Writes four long values into consecutive entries starting from a base value and stepping by 2400 each time, and records the base in a field. It is reached from a gap in the code.

name: fill_accumulating_entry_run
description: Writes a series of entries in which each value adds a stored step to the previous one, storing each as two words. The number of entries comes from a record field.

name: copy_table_block_to_record
description: Copies sixteen longwords from a table block selected by the input index into a record.

name: copy_table_block_to_global
description: Stores a pointer to a fixed global area in a record, then copies sixteen longwords from a table block selected by the index into that global area.

name: set_channel_flags_clear_status
description: Sets the high-bit pair in a word at an offset, clears a status bit in a state byte and zeroes a longword field, then returns the input with its low byte set.

name: set_channel_word_flags_variant
description: Sets the high-bit pair in a word at a different offset, clears the same status bit and zeroes the same longword field. It returns the input with its low byte set to a fixed value.

name: clear_status_and_zero_field
description: Clears a status bit in a state byte and zeroes a longword field, then returns the input with its low byte set to a fixed value.

name: compute_position_error
description: Returns the absolute difference between a stored value and a record field. The stored value is fifteen when a flag bit is clear.

name: wait_channel_idle_with_reset
description: Clears a field and calls several routines while temporarily setting a count field to fifteen, then spins while a busy bit in a status byte is set.

name: wait_channel_idle_restore
description: Saves a count field, zeroes it, calls two routines, restores the field, then waits while the busy bit in a status byte is set.

name: wait_channel_busy_clear
description: Spins until a busy bit in a status byte clears, then returns.

name: set_channel_busy_flag
description: When its argument is nonzero it calls a routine and sets a busy bit. Otherwise it clears the busy bit and another status bit.

name: store_channel_parameters
description: Stores two input words into one field pair, repeats the first word into another field and stores a further word into a fourth field.

name: negate_and_reload_step_counter
description: Negates one stored field, copies another field into a step counter and sets a status bit. The code is reached from a gap in the decode.

name: step_channel_envelope_frame
description: Decrements a per-frame counter and, when it underflows, reloads the step and toggles or restarts a status flag. It then refreshes the channel's bit-mask fields and writes a value into output buffers for each clear bit.

name: adjust_channel_level_toward_target
description: Moves a channel level toward a target in unit steps while it stays within bounds, then refreshes the output buffers for each clear bit.

name: apply_level_delta_and_refresh
description: Adds a delta to a channel level, then calls an unnamed routine sixteen times followed by further calls for the remaining step count.

name: add_signed_offset_pair
description: Adds a value from a table to each of two consecutive bytes, negating the value when the input is negative.

name: read_high_nibble_of_pair
description: Advances across two bytes and returns the high nibble of the second one.

name: compute_scaled_table_difference
description: Computes an array of bytes as the scaled difference between two tables over a count derived from a step field. The code is reached from a gap in the decode.

name: copy_three_byte_groups
description: Copies three-byte groups from a fixed table into the destination, one group per pass. The pass count comes from a record field.

name: clear_three_byte_groups
description: Waits until a busy bit clears, then zeroes a run of three-byte groups and clears a position field. The code is reached from a gap in the decode.

name: pack_nibbles_into_bytes
description: Writes two bytes, each holding the low nibble of successive input values shifted into the high nibble.

name: unpack_high_nibbles_groups
description: Initialises a counter and mask field, then extracts the high nibble of three bytes per group from a source table into a destination, repeating for the count stored in a field.

name: rebuild_active_slot_table
description: Clears a 16-entry byte table, then walks a linked list of records, marking each record's slot in the table and storing its index. A count field is set from the number of records processed.

name: tick_channel_timers
description: Decrements up to four channel timers and, on underflow, clears or sets status bits. It calls a routine when a select bit is set and, for one timer, loads a pointer-based value before returning.

name: invert_flagged_table_entries
description: Walks seven table entries, inverting each byte that is nonzero or has its mask bit set, and calls an unnamed routine for each one.

name: write_nibble_to_strided_rows
description: Sets an active flag, then writes a nibble-masked byte into thirteen rows spaced 40 bytes apart, or a single byte when the mode byte is zero.

name: step_idle_counter_toward_limit
description: When a status byte has its bit set and two state bytes are clear, it decrements a counter if nonzero and steps a value one unit at a time toward 38.

name: fill_accumulating_table_until_negative
description: Writes a running value into each table entry, adding the entry's step after each write, until an entry with a negative step ends the table.

name: scan_until_negative_link
description: Walks eight-byte entries until one has a negative second field, performing no other work. It is reached from a gap in the decode.

name: clear_memory_block_tag
description: Clears a memory region in 32-byte blocks from a fixed start up to an end value supplied by a call, then writes a four-character text tag to a fixed location.

name: wait_while_entry_negative
description: Checks the sign of a table entry and, while it is negative and a status bit is set, repeatedly calls two routines. It returns zero at the end.

name: update_channel_position_fields
description: Sums two pairs of offset fields and, when a pointer field is nonzero, stores a stepped pointer and a computed pair of values into that structure.

name: store_pointer_and_return
description: Stores a pointer field into a slot and returns the input with a fixed low byte value.

name: initialise_interrupt_vectors_and_chips
description: Initialises interrupt vectors and custom chip registers at startup: it copies a six-longword table into the low-memory vector area, clears a block of globals and writes interrupt and DMA control values. The hardware facts list the interrupt enable and request registers, DMA control, and CIA port B.

name: initialise_channel_buffer_table
description: Writes initial values into a small buffer, stores its address into two pointers, clears a field and writes a DMA control word.

name: mask_control_and_set_field
description: Stores a masked copy of a control word, sets a field to 4095 and returns the input value.

name: mask_control_and_set_field
description: Stores a masked copy of a control word, sets a field to 4095 and returns the input value.

name: mask_control_and_set_field
description: Stores a masked copy of a control word, sets a field to 4095 and returns the input value.

name: poll_until_zero_result
description: Calls an unnamed routine repeatedly until it returns zero.

name: set_status_bit_and_wait
description: Sets the top bit of a state byte and repeats while the previous value had that bit set, so it returns only once the bit was clear.

name: set_status_bit_wait_low
description: Sets bit eight of a state byte and repeats while the previous value had that bit set. The code is reached from a gap in the decode.

name: read_status_bits_masked
description: Returns a status byte masked to two selected bits.

name: poll_until_condition_met
description: Calls an unnamed routine in a loop until its result sets the condition flag. It is reached from a gap in the decode.

name: wait_status_bit_clear
description: Spins while bit two of a status byte is set, then returns.

name: find_region_offset
description: Scans a table of eight-word region records for one that contains the current two coordinates, returning minus one when none matches. A matched record with a chained pointer is followed and returns zero; otherwise the result is the offset of the position from the region start.

name: store_masked_control_and_limit
description: Stores a masked copy of a control word and, when the masked value is nonzero, sets a field to 4095.

name: read_cia_event_byte
description: Checks an interrupt-status byte for a CIA event, waits briefly, clears a control bit and reads a port byte into a table entry. When the stored flag is set it calls another routine. The facts list CIA port A as touched.

name: forward_call_unchanged
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns the input value unchanged.

name: map_key_code_to_entry
description: Records a character code in a state byte and, when a flag is set, looks up its entry in a 16-entry list and stores the entry's offset. It returns zero for a match and minus one when no entry is found. The decompiler reports bad instruction data after a branch, so the tail of the routine is unreliable.

name: append_char_to_ring_buffer
description: Writes a character into a 32-entry ring buffer and advances its write index, wrapping after thirty-one. A carriage return is stored as an asterisk and sets a flag.

name: expand_escaped_text_string
description: Copies a string into a buffer, expanding escape codes: a dollar sign introduces a substitution taken from the following character, and control characters below a space go to a helper. An asterisk ends the copy.

name: format_number_or_text_fragment
description: Writes a signed number with leading zeros suppressed when a bit test matches; otherwise it copies a text fragment with dollar-sign substitution from a table, ending with a space.

name: copy_text_fragment_with_escape
description: Copies characters until an asterisk, substituting a table entry when a dollar sign is followed by a digit and a flag is set, then appends a space.

name: copy_string_until_marker
description: Copies characters from one string into another up to a count, stopping at an asterisk, then writes an asterisk terminator. It is reached from a gap in the decode.

name: skip_marked_strings
description: Advances through a table of asterisk-terminated strings, skipping the number of strings given by the second argument, starting from an indexed table offset.

name: advance_position_by_step
description: Clears a pending pointer field if it is set, then adds a step value to a stored coordinate and calls two unnamed routines.

name: draw_text_glyph_rows
description: Draws characters from a text stream into a bitmap row buffer, using a bit mask to write each glyph's rows. Control codes switch the drawing mode, and the remaining rows are cleared when the text ends the line.

name: clear_buffer_rows
description: Clears a block of rows in a buffer, with the row count derived from a record field. It is reached from a gap in the decode.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without performing any operation. It is an empty stub.

name: forward_call_unchanged
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns its inputs unchanged. The text reference to vowel letters is not used by this wrapper.

name: measure_text_width_until
description: Scans bytes of a string until the target byte is reached, adding each character's table width plus one to a running total, and returns the total.

name: format_signed_decimal_five
description: Converts a signed 16-bit value to its absolute value and writes its decimal digits into fixed memory cells, with a leading sign handled by the caller. It returns a value from an offset table.

name: format_decimal_digits_cells
description: Writes the absolute value of a signed 16-bit input as decimal digits into four fixed memory cells. It is reached from a gap in the decode.

name: format_decimal_digits_cells
description: Writes the absolute value of an input register as decimal digits into four fixed memory cells.

name: format_decimal_digits_cells
description: Writes the absolute value of a 16-bit input as decimal digits into four fixed memory cells. It is called from three unnamed routines.

name: parse_decimal_digit_string
description: Parses a string of decimal digits into a number by weighting each digit with a table entry, after setting a bit in a status word.

name: handle_channel_control_flags
description: Updates a channel control word from a hardware status word: one set bit triggers a routine and clears a flag, another decrements two counters and clears a flag, and a final bit calls a handler through a stored pointer.

name: dispatch_by_status_flags
description: Calls one of two handlers from pointer tables when the matching status bit is set, returning its result. It returns minus one when neither bit is set.

name: advance_channel_state_frame
description: Advances a channel's frame counters when an active bit is set, calling helper routines and returning a result. It then processes a pending flag and a repeat flag.

name: update_joystick_position_clamped
description: Derives direction bits from a controller status word and moves two stored coordinates by the difference of their deltas, clamping each to a limit. It then packs four direction bits into a state byte. The facts list the CIA as touched.

name: step_byte_sequence_with_delay
description: Steps through a counted byte list, calling two unnamed routines for each entry until one has its sign bit clear. It then stores that entry's flags and runs a short delay loop.

name: delay_countdown_loop
description: Counts a 16-bit value down to minus one, providing a timing delay.

name: clear_status_bit_two
description: Clears bit two of a state byte and returns.

name: start_channel_transfer_job
description: Waits for a status bit to clear, sets it, installs a completion handler and initialises a job record's fields from a stored value, with a fixed length field of 426.

name: start_channel_transfer_and_wait
description: Waits for a status bit to clear, sets it, installs the completion handler and initialises a record's fields with a fixed length of 938. It then waits for the bit to clear again.

name: clear_word_buffer
description: Zero-fills a buffer in word units and clears one extra byte when the byte count is odd.

name: store_masked_byte_to_cell
description: Stores an input byte with its top bit cleared into a fixed memory cell. The facts list CIA port A and the vertical position register as touched; the routine is reached from a gap in the decode.

name: repeat_four_calls_while_flag
description: Calls four unnamed routines in a loop while a condition flag remains set, then returns.

name: write_error_tag_and_check
description: Sets a status bit, writes the four-character error tag into a global location and calls two routines. It returns zero when the check succeeds and minus one otherwise.

name: compare_longword_arrays
description: Compares two arrays of longwords element by element, returning minus one at the first mismatch and zero when all entries match.

name: select_table_entry_fields
description: Stores an address argument and an index into a record, derives a scaled value and a byte field from the table entry for that index, and returns the first table word.

name: write_tag_and_advance_slots
description: Writes a four-character tag into a fixed cell, then loops through up to fifteen slots, calling routines for each and advancing a pointer by a stride until a size limit is reached. It is reached from a gap in the decode.
